videos.headline: Lac-Mégantic, the channel's first Short with watch data: 450 views, and 43% stayed to watch.

why.text: 450 views so far; 10.7% came from search ('lac megantic train derailment'), more than the 2–3% the other channels get.
57.5% viewed, 43% stayed to watch and 23.2% held after the hook; no other Short has data yet to compare with.
The first fall, 15.6 points, came at 1.5 s during the hook line 'A train with no one aboard reached Lac-Mégantic. How?'; another 12.5 points left at 5.4 s on 'It was doing 65 miles an hour'.

videos.next: Put the runaway train moving on screen in the first second, before the question is spoken.
